verdict.rationale: Sentry provides a web API to manage and export account data (sentry-docs-14/20) and is open-source/self-hostable, letting users run their own instance and avoid lock-in (sentry-docs-11, sentry-comm-1/2). However there's no documented bulk 'export all data' feature or explicit open-format (e.g., CSV/JSON dump) guarantee, and self-hosting has known operational pain per community reports (sentry-comm-4/5/9). Missing for 10: a dedicated full-data-export tool/format documentation, and independent confirmation that exported data via API covers all issue/event history in an open format.
